The displaying of the image of the Ambassador to the rulers of darkness is a crucial moment in the history of salvation, and achieves a first purification of the light that is bound up in the rulers. This leads to the establishment of the heavenly bodies; to the beginnings of life on earth; and ultimately to the completion of the salvific process in the ascent of souls to the sun and the return to the kingdom.
